# v2026.11.11

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.11.11.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.11.11.md).

This release covers **3 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- An owner or admin can **Unlink** a job from a wrong invoice. Nothing is voided or written to Xero; the invoice keeps its number and waits on Reconcile for its right job. ([#521](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/521))
- A remake that a non-chargeable rule matches gets its draft on the Non-chargeable tab, even when its first job's invoice has the same Reference. ([#520](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/520))

## Changes

- **Unlink** in a job's More menu (owner or admin), with a reason. The job waits on hold until a person links its right invoice. ([#521](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/521))

## Fixes

- A remake's non-chargeable draft is no longer refused on every pass because of its first job's Reference. ([#520](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/520))

## Contribution record

[CHANGELOG/records/2026.11.11.md](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/blob/main/CHANGELOG/records/2026.11.11.md) lists every pull request in this release once, with its related issues and thanks.
